title: Free text, callout and cloud annotations with a CLI host
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-edit --test real_document_annotations and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli pass; pdfxi annotate add writes real FreeText / callout / Polygon cloud annotations that survive a save and can be listed back; REVIEW-002 moves to verified.
notes: Adds add_free_text, add_callout and add_cloud to the document-level annotation writers and hosts them in pdfxi annotate add/list with rect/anchor parsing and typed validation.
